sample_unit: FDA 510(k) summaries of AI radiology devices (2024-2025)
unlisted_practices: Recompute PPV, FDR and FOR for FDA-authorized radiology AI devices at real-world clinical disease prevalence from 510(k) sensitivity and specificity

screen.reason: Analyzes real-world clinical implications (specifically the false positive paradox under varying clinical prevalence) of FDA-cleared radiology AI devices using data from 510(k) summaries.
